subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes + context length profiling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@finlytics.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:02:00Z
Subject: Great meeting — token volumes & context profiling follow-up

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the detailed walkthrough of the document processing use case. A quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get you a targeted pricing estimate: 

- Confirmed scope: automated extraction + summarization for regulatory reports (PDFs and long transcripts).
- Key unknown for pricing: average prompt size, average completion size, and what percentage of requests need long context (8k / 32k / 128k).

Action items I promised:
1) A short template you can fill with token profiling (I’ve attached an example CSV to show the fields we need).
2) A back-of-envelope pricing model for a few volume scenarios once we get the profile.

Can you send avg prompt tokens and avg completion tokens, plus an estimate of your histogram (percent of requests per context bucket: <=8k, 8k-32k, 32k-128k, >128k)? Even ballpark percentages are fine.

Attachment: finlytics-context-profiling.csv (template)

Thanks — I’ll loop Rishi in for any technical questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Great meeting — token volumes & context profiling follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the clear note and template. Attaching a filled CSV and a short internal note on variability. High level numbers:

- Avg prompt tokens: 420
- Avg completion tokens: 1,600
- Context needs (approx): 70% <=8k, 25% 8k-32k, 5% 32k-128k, <1% >128k (mostly executive transcripts we keep long)
- Monthly request volume: ~1.2M requests (we estimate ~40% for summarization, 60% for extraction)
- Growth: expecting 30%+ YoY as we roll out to two more product lines this year

We attached the filled profiling CSV and a short note on how completion length spikes for board transcripts. Hope this helps — happy to hop on a quick call if Rishi needs more detail.

Attachment: finlytics-context-profiling.csv

Best,
Samantha Park
Head of Data Products | FinLytics Inc
Samantha.Park@finlytics.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Great meeting — token volumes & context profiling follow-up

Thanks for the numbers, Samantha — this is great and very actionable. A couple quick clarifying questions from the infra/pricing side: 

- Is the avg prompt token count (420) measured inclusive of system/instruction tokens or just user prompt? If you include system, can you separate if possible?
- For the 5% that require 32k-128k, what’s the typical completion length — do those run longer completions or are they mostly long prompts with short extracts?

Preliminary note on unit economics (back-of-envelope):
- Using your mix + 1.2M monthly requests and avg sizes: rough token volume ~ (1.2M * (420 + 1,600)) = ~2.4B tokens/mo.
- Weighted context needs increase effective cost due to longer KV cache and memory footprint; long-context requests (even small %) can push model selection to 32k/128k variants which affects $/1M tokens.

I'll prepare two sample pricing scenarios (conservative / optimized) and a short ops note on caching strategies to reduce unit cost (prefix caching for repeated doc headers, persistent KV for multi-turn summaries).

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Great meeting — token volumes & context profiling follow-up

Rishi/Marissa — quick answers from my engineering lead after we pulled some logs:

- The 420 prompt tokens includes system instructions. Split is approx system=60 tokens, user=360 tokens.
- For the 5% 32k-128k requests: those are usually long transcripts where prompt ~18k tokens and completion ~3k tokens.
- Completion distribution: most completions are 800-2,000 tokens; board minutes occasionally spike to 5k.

Also, we have an internal budget target of around $800-$1,200 per 1M tokens for inference (this is what the executive team prefers for planning). Please highlight which scenarios hit that target and where tradeoffs are needed.

Tom
Engineering Director | FinLytics Inc
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@finlytics.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T16:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Great meeting — token volumes & context profiling follow-up

Thanks Tom / Samantha — this is super helpful and gives us what we need to produce a concrete pricing recommendation. Quick summary and next steps: 

Summary of profile (per your numbers):
- Avg prompt tokens: 360 user + 60 system = 420
- Avg completion tokens: ~1,600 (typical), with spikes up to 5k for board minutes
- Context bucket mix: 70% <=8k, 25% 8k-32k, 5% 32k-128k (prompt ~18k + completion ~3k for those)
- Monthly volume: ~1.2M requests (~2.4B tokens/mo estimated)

Next steps (we'll deliver by end of day Friday):
1) Rishi will send two pricing scenarios: a) conservative (assume higher 128k model usage) b) optimized (batching + prefix caching + model selection) with estimated $/1M tokens.
2) I'll include a sample Dedicated commitment option (reserved capacity) that shows how unit price drops at different commit levels and the SLA differences.
3) We’ll flag where your $800-$1,200 / 1M token target is realistic vs. where tradeoffs (quantization, batching, caching) are needed.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.pdf (draft)

If helpful we can set a 30-minute call Monday to walk through the scenarios — propose Mon 03/09 10:00-10:30 PT.

Thanks — will follow up with the estimate and a short ops playbook.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
